name: Infographic
description: A chart of a report's top rows on the brand's paper: a bar chart, a line or a number grid, with a chip naming the report. Bind it to a report and its data table (the first table in the report) or its metrics fill the rows: every figure is the report's own, exactly as written, and a claim bound to it. A render checks the chart still matches its report. Five rows at most.

eyebrow.label: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: A short label in the dark pill, e.g. SEPTEMBER IN NUMBERS. Leave empty for none.

headline.label: Headline
headline.description: The big statement. Use | to break the line, e.g. WHERE OUR|REACH CAME|FROM.

headline_accent.label: Accent words
headline_accent.description: Words of the headline shown in the brand colour, exactly as they appear in it. Leave empty for none.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: What the figures measure, e.g. Unique accounts reached, per channel. Binding a report fills in its figures' column name; change it freely.

chart.label: Chart
chart.description: bar, line or grid. A bar or a line compares figures in one unit (a bar: none negative); the grid shows any figures. A chart its figures cannot make shows as the grid.

row_1_label.label: Row 1 label
row_1_label.description: Row 1's name, as the report has it: its table's first column, or a metric's name.

row_1_value.label: Row 1 figure
row_1_value.description: Row 1's figure, exactly as the report wrote it, e.g. 48,210 or 5.2%. A claim: bind it to the report.

row_2_label.label: Row 2 label
row_2_label.description: Row 2's name, as the report has it. Leave empty (with its figure) for a shorter chart.

row_2_value.label: Row 2 figure
row_2_value.description: Row 2's figure, exactly as the report wrote it, e.g. 48,210 or 5.2%. A claim: bind it to the report.

row_3_label.label: Row 3 label
row_3_label.description: Row 3's name, as the report has it. Leave empty (with its figure) for a shorter chart.

row_3_value.label: Row 3 figure
row_3_value.description: Row 3's figure, exactly as the report wrote it, e.g. 48,210 or 5.2%. A claim: bind it to the report.

row_4_label.label: Row 4 label
row_4_label.description: Row 4's name, as the report has it. Leave empty (with its figure) for a shorter chart.

row_4_value.label: Row 4 figure
row_4_value.description: Row 4's figure, exactly as the report wrote it, e.g. 48,210 or 5.2%. A claim: bind it to the report.

row_5_label.label: Row 5 label
row_5_label.description: Row 5's name, as the report has it. Leave empty (with its figure) for a shorter chart.

row_5_value.label: Row 5 figure
row_5_value.description: Row 5's figure, exactly as the report wrote it, e.g. 48,210 or 5.2%. A claim: bind it to the report.

source_caption.label: Source caption
source_caption.description: The word before the source in its chip, e.g. Source.

source_label.label: Source
source_label.description: The report the figures come from, as it resolves: its title and the day it was made. Binding a report fills it in, and a render checks it.

note.label: Note
note.description: A line under the chart, e.g. The top 5 of the 6 channels we posted on. Leave empty for none.

counter.label: Page counter
counter.description: For a post in a series, e.g. 02 / 10. Leave empty for none.

handle.label: Handle
handle.description: The account handle shown top right, e.g. @yourbrand. Leave empty for none.

cta.label: Call to action
cta.description: The footer's call to action, e.g. Save this post. Leave empty for none.
